title: Goal
description: A standing goal (owner: Lane B reducer, with Lane A). The cap is the ceiling the agent may hunt under; spending above the buyer's allowance always needs a call.

skipped_owned_part_id.description: Set when ownership memory dropped this line; the card cites that OwnedPart.

deadline.description: ISO datetime; passing it means EXPIRED plus a notification.

parent_goal_id.description: Private local relation to the parent build goal; omitted on parent goals.

parent_part.description: Exact SKU of the parent build item represented by this child; omitted on parent goals.
